{{Top|leg}}
The '''En'Tra'Ag'Tra''' ("King-Master's highest-servants") was the collection of noble families that served the [[En'Tra]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coyn]]. There were twenty-nine noble families, each led by an [[Ag'Tra]], and ruling over a [[Sarrh'Tais]].
